subtitle: Lesson 3 · SQL Server Internals Through T-SQL

code:
sys.dm_exec_*   query execution: requests,
                sessions, sql text, plans

sys.dm_os_*     OS-level: wait stats, memory,
                schedulers, perf counters

sys.dm_db_*     database-level: index stats,
                missing indexes, file space

sys.dm_io_*     I/O: virtual file stats
caption: The prefix after dm_ tells you what area a DMV or DMF covers.

code:
SELECT r.session_id, r.status, r.command,
       r.wait_type, r.cpu_time,
       r.total_elapsed_time
FROM sys.dm_exec_requests AS r
WHERE r.session_id <> @@SPID
ORDER BY r.total_elapsed_time DESC;
caption: sys.dm_exec_requests — one row per currently executing request.
